TooltipField.Name: The ability name shown in chat and on the created action item.
TooltipField.Description: Flavor text that appears before the @Damage, @Check, @Template buttons.
TooltipField.DamageType: Damage type: fire, cold, acid, slashing, piercing, etc.
TooltipField.DamagePrecision: Adds the [precision] trait — bonus damage from precise strikes.
TooltipField.DamageSplash: Adds the [splash] trait — splash damage to adjacent creatures.
TooltipField.DamagePersistent: Makes this persistent damage (applied over time).
TooltipField.DamageHealing: Marks this term as healing instead of damage.
TooltipField.DamageMaterial: Material damage effect (cold-iron, silver) for resistance bypass.
TooltipField.DamageSanctification: Holy or unholy sanctification trait for the @Damage button.
TooltipField.DamageExtraTraits: Extra traits for the @Damage button, comma-separated.
TooltipField.DamageLabel: Custom button label instead of the formula.
TooltipField.DamageAreaDamage: Adds the area-damage option (breath weapons, AoE).
TooltipField.CheckType: Save type (Reflex, Fortitude, Will, Perception) or skill.
TooltipField.CheckMode: How the DC is determined: fixed value, vs defense, or vs target DC.
TooltipField.CheckDC: The DC value for this check (DC mode).
TooltipField.CheckDefense: Defense to compare against: AC, Fortitude, Reflex, Will, Perception.
TooltipField.CheckAgainst: Compare against Class DC or Spell DC of the target.
TooltipField.CheckBasic: Basic save — half damage on success.
TooltipField.CheckShowDC: Who sees the DC in chat: Owner, GM, All, or None.
TooltipField.CheckExtraTraits: Extra traits for the check, comma-separated.
TooltipField.CheckSecret: Secret check — only the GM sees the roll result.
TooltipField.CheckIncapacitation: Incapacitation trait — if the target's level exceeds the effect's level, the result is worsened by one step (critical success → success, success → failure, failure → critical failure). Affects spells and effects like slow, paralyze, etc.
TooltipField.CheckImmutable: Immutable — the check cannot be modified by external abilities (e.g. Weak / Elite adjustment, aura effects). The roll uses the exact value rolled.
TooltipField.CheckDamagingEffect: Marks the effect with the damaging-effect option. Used to identify effects that deal damage for purposes of immunities, weakness interaction, and the «ready» action.
TooltipField.CheckBreathWeapon: Marks the check as a breath weapon (action:breath-weapon). This is used by dragon breath attacks and similar cone/line abilities that can be used once per combat.
TooltipField.TemplateType: Shape of the area: cone, burst, emanation, or line.
TooltipField.TemplateWidth: Line width (leave empty for standard 5 ft).
TooltipField.PresetSelect: Load a built-in or custom preset configuration.
TooltipField.ActionActions: Number of actions required to use the ability, or «Passive» if always active.
TooltipField.ActionFrequency: How often the ability can be used. «At will» means unlimited uses.
TooltipField.ActionFrequencyUses: Maximum uses per the selected frequency period.
TooltipField.EffectCritSuccess: @UUID of an effect item applied on critical success. Example: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}
TooltipField.EffectSuccess: @UUID of an effect item applied on success.
TooltipField.EffectFailure: @UUID of an effect item applied on failure.
TooltipField.EffectCritFailure: @UUID of an effect item applied on critical failure.
